## d0496e8fd941

**Reproduced distribution gap / possible shortcut — default generation never emits the identity branch.**

The source defines `touching_selected_identity`, allows identity output, and documents `public_test_1` as the identity-output canonical branch. However, its default slot pools explicitly exclude the identity profile. I sampled 1,600 default draws: 50 seeds × 8 sample indices × four difficulty bands. All 1,600 changed at least one cell; zero were identity outputs. The identity profile did produce an unchanged output when requested by exact override.

Machine-readable reproduction: `checks/audits/d0496e8fd941-default-identity-gap.json`.

This allows a training shortcut: “the output must always change something,” even though the canonical query can legitimately be unchanged. Override reachability and explicit unit tests do not compensate if ordinary data production never samples the branch.

The structural checker itself passed its focused self-check stage (`checks/audits/compact/d0496e8fd941-selfcheck-stage.log`). A separate semantic-gate probe failed because no formal semantic contract hook is declared (`checks/audits/compact/d0496e8fd941-semantic-contract-stage.log`), which makes the default-frequency omission harder for current admission tooling to catch.

triage.reason: Brief-reviewed under October 3 lightweight policy; preserve reported evidence and findings. Shared-tool requests consolidated separately. No maintainer battery/test/private-solve rerun or automatic training admission.
